findings: Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts gates tool calls while rewind is pending; likely usability risk because ordinary navigation tools may also be unavailable until rewind resolves.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/frame.ts FrameList.handleInput maps Ctrl-C to onCancel and Escape clears search before cancelling in list focus. Likely defect: leaveSearch restores by prior index, which may select a different item after filtering.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/index.ts buildContextMessages freezes context at the pending instruction, and tool calls are blocked during pending rewind; README describes Escape as explicit cancellation. Potential usability concern: blocked navigation may leave user Escape as the only escape route.
Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/history-outline.ts patchedInput clears search/query on tui.select.cancel before invoking list.onCancel; F2 toggles the raw tree view.

Verified source/test documentation: extensions/navigate-tree/frame.test.ts covers Escape clearing search before cancellation, Ctrl-C cancellation from either focus, and filtered selection retaining original indices; these are source observations, not claims of executed tests.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/continuity-capture.ts captureIntent accepts AbortSignal and on abort returns no ops while restoring the prior watermark. Likely tradeoff: retry can rescan entries classified before cancellation.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/fold-screen.ts openFoldScreen/pickAnchor permits leaving before confirmation; foldTo revalidates anchor and label after confirmation. Potential usability concern: askLabel normalizes typed labels to kebab-case, which may surprise users.

Verified: extensions/navigate-tree/tree-screen.ts goTo checks busy state before and after confirmation and handles cancelled navigation without moving; openTreeScreen retains keyed focus across filters. extensions/navigate-tree/anchor-command.ts returns on Escape from anchor list and routes r to fold.
